nary_nodes.label: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's rumoured wedding celebrations begin
evidence: Taylor Swift and her American football-player fiancé Travis Kelce have kicked off rumoured wedding celebrations at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

nary_nodes.label: High-profile friends spotted in formal attire
evidence: High-profile friends of the couple, from actress Lena Dunham to frequent collaborator Jack Antonoff were spotted Thursday evening in formal attire.

nary_nodes.label: Guests dropped off under white canopy tent
evidence: Aerial footage showed a stream of black SUVs pulling up to the venue with guests dropped off under a white canopy tent.

nary_nodes.label: Event dubbed pre-party or rehearsal dinner
evidence: Media speculation has dubbed the event both a pre-party and possible rehearsal dinner.

nary_nodes.label: Around 100 people expected on Thursday
evidence: Around 100 people were expected at the event on Thursday

nary_nodes.label: Up to 1,000 guests expected on Friday
evidence: ahead of a much larger celebration on Friday boasting up to 1,000 guests at the arena.

nary_nodes.label: Cops present in heat
evidence: Throughout the day on Thursday, a small army of cops sweated it out in asphalt-curdling heat

nary_nodes.label: Camera crews tried to catch a glimpse
evidence: while camera crews tried to catch a glimpse of anything that would confirm what was happening inside the arena

nary_nodes.label: TMZ fired up a live feed
evidence: Celebrity gossip outlet TMZ fired up a live feed of what appeared to be one of the Garden's loading bays

nary_nodes.label: Men hauled cardboard boxes from van
evidence: Viewers who tuned in at approximately 18:00 ET (22:00 GMT) could see, in real time, as several men in cargo shorts hauled cardboard boxes from the back of a van.

nary_nodes.label: Police plunked down metal barricades
evidence: Reporters chronicled every metal barricade plunked down by police

nary_nodes.label: People told to move back from arena
evidence: each time people were told to move back from areas near the arena, to make way for the event and guests.

nary_nodes.label: Cameras spotted a large sign
evidence: Cameras spotted a large sign near an entrance that warned those going inside the venue from 29 June - 3 July would be consenting to video and photos being taken inside the arena for an "event"

nary_nodes.label: Sign suggested filming inside
evidence: suggesting there was perhaps filming happening inside during the preparations.

nary_nodes.label: Couple donated to charities
evidence: On Thursday evening, the couple donated $26m (£19.4m) to charities in the US close to their hearts

nary_nodes.label: Donation for 'charities across the United States'
evidence: Swift's representatives, while not mentioning anything about a wedding, told BBC News the donation which included food banks, was for "charities across the United States".

nary_nodes.label: Permit detailed event schedule
evidence: A permit for the events on Thursday and Friday obtained by the Associated Press said about 100 guests would start arriving around 17:30 ET for a "pre-party night", which would go until 22:30 ET.

nary_nodes.label: Guests not allowed phones during ceremony
evidence: Guests at the wedding will reportedly not be allowed to have their phones during the main ceremony

nary_nodes.label: Main ceremony expected to begin with cocktails
evidence: which is expected to begin with mid-afternoon cocktails before a reception going into the night.

nary_nodes.label: BBC confirmed canopy tent for guest arrivals
evidence: As crews were setting up on Thursday, the BBC confirmed a large white canopy tent sitting outside the venue was to be used for guest arrivals

nary_nodes.label: VIPs planned underground entry
evidence: though VIPs like Swift and Kelce still planned to use underground entry to the arena for added privacy.

nary_nodes.label: Fans gathered outside
evidence: Fans gathered outside, even after their mayor explicitly and repeatedly told them to please stay inside on a day when temperatures topped 100F (37C).

nary_nodes.label: Ryan Weng wants to see alleged wedding
evidence: "I'm here to see the alleged wedding," said Swift fan Ryan Weng, "because I've been loving her for more than 15 years, so it's going to be a very, very amazing and irreplaceable experience for me and my entire life."

nary_nodes.label: Rusty Carbaug dropped by Garden
evidence: Fellow fan Rusty Carbaug, a pilot in her 30s who dropped by the Garden to wish Swift well, donned a Kansas-themed T-shirt in honour of Kelce, who plays for the Kansas City Chiefs.

nary_nodes.label: Carbaug grew in music taste with Swift
evidence: "I feel like I grew in my music taste with her," said Carbaug, adding: "The right man for her is whoever she chooses."

nary_nodes.label: Media outlets watched outside arena
evidence: For several days, media outlets have watched every move outside the arena.

nary_nodes.label: Trucks with cryptic labels spotted
evidence: They spotted trucks with cryptic labels like "GP" and "garden party" on it

nary_nodes.label: Crews unloading tons of equipment
evidence: and crews unloading tons of equipment and things like large white staircase prop and large mirror ball.

nary_nodes.label: Workers rolled out red carpet
evidence: Earlier in the week, workers were seen rolling out a red carpet, which was hastily withdrawn.

nary_nodes.label: Mayor Mamdani alluded to wedding chatter
evidence: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, an astute student of both politics and pop culture, has coyly alluded to the wedding chatter during press conferences.

nary_nodes.label: City officials confirmed street closure permit application
evidence: City officials confirmed to the BBC that somebody applied for street closure permits in the area, but did not reveal whom.

nary_nodes.label: City not likely to shut down corridor for just anybody
evidence: But the city is not likely to have shut down Manhattan's busiest corridor on a holiday weekend for just anybody.

nary_nodes.label: Celebrities started to emerge
evidence: Then the celebrities started to emerge.

nary_nodes.label: Paparazzi captured images of Antonoff
evidence: Paparazzi captured images of Antonoff, Swift's longtime producer, sporting a tux and a toothpick dangling out of his mouth, reportedly heading to Thursday's event at the Garden.

nary_nodes.label: Rachel Antonoff followed closely behind
evidence: His sister Rachel Antonoff, a designer, followed closely behind in a bubblegum-pink dress.

nary_nodes.label: Erin Andrews seen in silver sparkly gown
evidence: Famed American sports broadcaster Erin Andrews was also seen in a silver sparkly gown

nary_nodes.label: Tree Paine wore a light blue dress
evidence: and Swift's longtime publicist, Tree Paine, wore a light blue dress.

nary_nodes.label: Page Six reported Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid arrived
evidence: US tabloid Page Six reported Bradley Cooper and Gigi Hadid, a longtime member of Swift's friend circle, had also arrived at the venue.

nary_nodes.label: Selena Gomez posted images on Instagram
evidence: Pop star and actress Selena Gomez posted images of herself on Instagram wearing a black gown with gem earrings and heading to an unspecified event.

nary_nodes.label: People Magazine published video of Dunham
evidence: People Magazine published a video of Dunham, who created the series Girls, being chauffeured through Manhattan in a black SUV.

nary_nodes.label: Swift left Thursday night's event
evidence: Swiftreportedly left Thursday night's eventat Madison Square Garden well after midnight, arriving home in the early hours of Friday morning.

nary_nodes.label: Students realized event was real due to street closures
evidence: But when they heard about the street closures, they realised, "OK, this is gonna be something real. It's gonna be happening", Mason said.

nary_nodes.label: Maxey believes Swift can make anything look pretty
evidence: With Swift's resources, "You're gonna be able to make anything look pretty," Maxey chimed in.

nary_nodes.label: Bonne praised Swift's venue decision for privacy
evidence: Laura Bonne, a 20 year old tourist visiting from Belgium who was waiting outside the Garden, praised Swift's decision on the venue. "I think its nice because she'll have a lot of privacy."
